query:
SELECT b.sha256
        FROM blob b
        WHERE b.sha256 IN (
            SELECT a.blob_sha256
            FROM component c
            JOIN asset a ON a.component_id = c.id
            WHERE c.repository_id = $1 AND c.name = $2 AND c.version = ANY($3)
        )
        ORDER BY b.sha256
        FOR UPDATE OF b
